criteria.requirement: Add Path.walk_controlled(*,follow_symlinks=False,max_depth=None,exclude=(),stable=False,errors="strict"). Yield Path descendants in depth-first preorder, root depth=0; exclude relative POSIX fnmatch patterns before yielding or descending, optionally sort names per directory. Default yields links without following directory links; opted-in following tracks directory (device,inode) identities to prevent cycles/repeated subtree traversal. Respect original error handler resolution and caller Path subclass; close scandir handles, validate policies, preserve legacy walk and do not follow links implicitly.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
